flows.name: Compare named project margin to date
steps: Scroll to the project margin visualization
Confirm the bars represent named projects from canonical WIP data
Confirm the invalid non-project X bar and redundant description are absent
Inspect the exact route at desktop and mobile widths
flows.expectedOutcome: Accounting users see internally consistent billed-to-date minus costs-to-date margin for real named projects without technical non-project artifacts or responsive regressions

checks: No invalid Unnamed project or X bar

claims.description: The Accounting dashboard uses the canonical WIP portfolio owner for project margin
The chart exposes real human project names and excludes the known non-project X artifact
The authenticated Accounting route remains dark, readable, and overflow-free at desktop and mobile widths
